QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] After a Pleasant Voyage
QuestInfo.0: You awaken in a deserted-looking fishing village after being caught in a storm during your trip to Commerci. What is this place? What happened to the ship? Is Parbell okay...? You should find out where you are.
QuestInfo.1: You awaken in a deserted-looking fishing village after being caught in a storm during your trip to Commerci. What is this place? What happened to the ship? Is Parbell okay...? You should find out where you are.
QuestInfo.2: You got swept up by a storm on your way to Commerci, and found yourself in the deserted fishing village of Berry. Thankfully, this land seems to be Commerci, your destination. Spend some time in the town earning the people's trust.
